description: tvOS Portal 2 client: the Portal tvOS profile's static composition, pins, SDL3 app shell, Apple TV render defaults and native Vulkan renderer over MoltenVK, with the portal2 game target. Built on Linux by build-tvos-portal2-app.sh (build-ios-portal2-app.sh with this profile); signed and installed on a Mac.

intent.support_scope: tvOS build slice for the separate Portal 2 target (user direction, 2026-09-28: 'build portal 2 for tvos and deploy enough to boot sp_a2_core'). Product scope like the Portal tvOS profile; nothing of that profile's device evidence carries over.
intent.packaging: .app assembled on Linux, signed and installed on the Mac by ios-deploy.sh --profile with this profile. Licensed retail Portal 2 content is staged from a Steam installation by tools/quality/stage_portal2_runtime.py and copied into the app's Library/Caches separately.
intent.physics_provider: vphysics_box3d (Box3D), as in ./play_p2 and the Portal tvOS profile (launcher_main/ios_main.cpp)
intent.video_provider: none: the Bink provider needs FFmpeg, which no Apple profile pins; the menu uses the staged background image

tvos.bundle_id_reason: The Portal 2 iOS profile's bundle id, as the Portal tvOS profile shares the Portal iOS one: one app record can carry both platforms. Agent decision, 2026-09-28.

static_composition.note: Portal 2's game modules declare the script manager as a shared app system in static products; the composition root links vscript and binds it (launcher_main/static_composition.cpp).

content.staging: tools/quality/stage_portal2_runtime.py --mount-custom, shared with the Portal 2 iOS profile (the same retail search paths and staged directory)

known_blockers: Retail Portal 2 content is about 12 GB, in Library/Caches, which tvOS may purge
